name: 「給料が上がると、性格も変わる?」(再制作版・最新仕様)

p_9411d75dcc.sentence: What’s more, if we get excited just by looking at which way the arrows point, we can lose sight of the size of the numbers.
p_9411d75dcc.prev: If we try to sum this up by saying “their personality got better,” we leave out too much.
p_9411d75dcc.next: When the strength of the links was measured on the same scale, the largest estimated values were 0.0630 for conscientiousness and −0.0096 for agreeableness.

p_83c82abb4c.sentence: The researchers also say they cannot establish cause and effect.
p_83c82abb4c.prev: Not every part of personality moves in the same way when income rises.
p_83c82abb4c.next: So the point is not that the study proves “personality changed because income rose,” but that the arrows are small and point in different directions.

p_adbee7e1ee.sentence: You look at the amount in your paycheck and can’t help smiling.
p_adbee7e1ee.prev: The Unexpected Divide Between Money and Personality
p_adbee7e1ee.next: Now you have more peace of mind, and work and relationships are going great.

p_f8e5e65b93.sentence: Now you have more peace of mind, and work and relationships are going great.
p_f8e5e65b93.prev: You look at the amount in your paycheck and can’t help smiling.
p_f8e5e65b93.next: If your personality improved too, it would be a major upgrade to your life.

p_39dfde4eeb.sentence: The links between rising income and later changes in personality pointed in different directions, depending on the trait.
p_39dfde4eeb.prev: But when we look at studies on the link between income and personality, it’s too soon to sound the fanfare for “all stats up!”
p_39dfde4eeb.next: First, here’s a result you might hope for.

p_c8f268b0db.sentence: Rising income was weakly linked to later decreases in “agreeableness,” the tendency to cooperate with others, and “extraversion,” being outgoing and actively engaging with people.
p_c8f268b0db.prev: But the arrows point the other way for the next traits.
p_c8f268b0db.next: Doing things properly” and “getting along well with people” both sound like praise, yet their links with rising income pointed in opposite directions.
